rationale: The workflow already implements several optimizations: concurrency cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), custom timeouts on all jobs (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), and a custom caching action for Go dependencies in the main and qemu jobs (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). The native job matrix lacks explicit caching, but the evidence for P-LIT-GHA-CACHE uses actions/cache on Linux only, while the native job runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux ARM64. Cross-platform cache paths are not addressed in the evidence, and the repository's custom caching action may not support those platforms. Reducing the existing 10-minute timeouts lacks per-job duration evidence. The default fail-fast behavior is already enabled for matrix jobs. No other pattern from the catalogue applies with sufficient evidence for this workflow.
